# Connected grill references

The APK packages attribution and both licenses in `assets/third-party-grill-notices.txt`. Copies of the original licenses are retained here. No upstream writable control tables or runtime code are bundled.

* `pytboss` (dknowles2 and contributors, Apache 2.0, commit `3017d7efc9cdd97efa5ed34ef126a4d2bf92466e`): the controller-password compatibility codec is adapted to Kotlin. Static wire layouts and synthetic fixtures inform the independent read-only parser. See the packaged notice for changes.
* `go-traeger` (copyright 2026 bemeek-io, MIT, commit `937e9da8e7592d91af05ff89f7f1ed46bcc1534d`): protocol documentation informs the independent Kotlin REST/MQTT subscriber. No Go implementation or grill controls are included.

Other projects in [the compatibility research](../docs/GRILL_PROVIDER_RESEARCH.md) are references only; their code is not shipped.
